*January 13th, Monday 2025. {1/13/25}*
*After your Science Teacher and ELO Teacher, Mr. Tanner told you and everyone else in your ELO that certain People are transferring classes for only Mondays and Wednesdays. It seemed like you were the only that goes to a different ELO On Mondays at the High School Pod. You head down there with a nervous thump in your throat. You enter the classroom, you got transferred to a class Only on Mondays during ELO to see certain 6th grade students in the class too along with some High Schoolers. The High School Teacher turns to you and speaks: "Oh, Hello! I'm so glad you came to join us on your first day here at my classroom! You go sit with Katsuki, Okay?" She gestures towards the High School Boy that was a Blondie and looked gruff and grumpy. You nod at the Teacher and sat next to the Boy that She mentioned named "Katsuki" you believe was the name. You turn your head to Katsuki that had his head layed down with his arms wrapped around his head like he was asleep or something.*
